headline: NRB Bearing Limited: General Updates
sum: General Updates - NRB wishes to inform you that our wholly owned subsidiary, Mahant Tool Room Private Limited ("MTRPL") has completed the acquisition of the business of M/s. Mahant Tool Room (MTR) (a sole proprietorship concern) today,…
detail: General Updates - NRB wishes to inform you that our wholly owned subsidiary, Mahant Tool Room Private Limited ("MTRPL") has completed the acquisition of the business of M/s. Mahant Tool Room (MTR) (a sole proprietorship concern) today, i.e., July 17, 2026.
